canopy.R12_9_folded_wing: Photo-based inferred profile concentrates the existing <=21.5 m peak at the north-west roof corner and tapers along the two adjacent eaves to 17.6 m. Registered orthophoto XY and 0.18 m shell thickness are unchanged. No measured roof elevation/profile is available.
canopy.eaves_limit: The 2023 imagery traces visible roof/eaves only and does not verify structural walls or courtyard edges.

upper_glazing.note: Expanded R12.5 visual window band to z=12.35–18.85 m and added vertical framing plus a middle transom using the large curtainwall zone visible in the 2016 project photographs. Approximate location/cadence; no dimensioned elevation.

sunshades.source_note: Photo-derived projecting aluminum fins aligned to curtainwall transoms; Kawneer identifies a Versoleil outrigger shading system. Fin depth, location and cadence are visual estimates, not an as-built schedule.
